final: WITH circuit_counts AS (SELECT c.circuitId, c.country, COUNT(r.raceId) AS race_count FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE r.date >= '1978-03-04' AND r.date <= '2003-03-09' GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.country), country_averages AS (SELECT country, AVG(race_count) AS avg_race_count FROM circuit_counts GROUP BY country) SELECT cc.circuitId, cc.country, cc.race_count, 1.0 * cc.race_count / ca.avg_race_count AS ratio FROM circuit_counts cc JOIN country_averages ca ON cc.country = ca.country ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
